title: 5-star review 2
content:
Hello Sir/Madam 😊
Thank you once again for choosing us for your *CCTV installation*. It was our pleasure to serve you.
 
For your peace of mind, we are offering a *15-Day Replacement Promise*. If any device covered under warranty has a fault during this period, we will *replace it with a brand-new unit instead of repairing it*.
 
If you are happy with our service, we would truly appreciate a *5-star review on Google*. Your support helps our small business grow and helps other customers trust our service.
 
Please leave your review here:
*https://gpage.short.gy/CCTV*
 
After posting the review, kindly *send us a screenshot*, so we can *activate your 15-Day Replacement Promise*.
 
Thank you for your support 🙏
